test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'STATION' is written as 'YKSSNXK', and 'COMPANY' is written as 'KFCOYWC'. How will 'ADVISOR' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

'STATION' is written as 'YKSSNXK'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d70241020dbe2a728758280b27be68e0c125025e68e7359b513ffa8e5d248aee.png] 

And,

'COMPANY' is written as 'KFCOYWC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b19d101b5c86d104a9f8c36d537ed90b199999bca380e36cca96ee57123adcb4.png] 

Similarly,

'ADVISOR' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88b03aaff147d146400e3eafee54292f6692c8050bd2703ee6aa22112209f7f6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"TUAHRXU".**
